en_us.title: Modpack Update Available
message: A new modpack version is available.
Current version: {current_version}
Latest version: {latest_version}
Update highlights:
Fixes:
[+] Fixed Magic Ore Detection being unable to detect ores through blocks.
- Previously, it only made ores glow without revealing them through blocks.
[+] Fixed a longstanding issue that prevented most background music tracks from playing.
- Previously, only some tracks could be played.
[+] Fixed an issue where the shader settings screen could appear blank due to mod conflicts.
New Content:
[+] Added a background to the Spirit Fox race selection screen.
[+] Added a config option to enable or disable player race models.
- This may be useful when using mods that alter the default Steve model.
[+] Added two Ultimate Skills: Manas · Ciel and Fortuna, Lord of Fate.
- See the Wiki for detailed skill descriptions.
[+] Added more biomes with integrated Tensura mob spawning.
- The new biomes bring more variety to your adventures.
[+] Added a Nature's Aura quest chapter and compatibility integration patch.
- This expands the modpack's gameplay and may enable more automated production options in the future.
[+] Added the Ancient Forest as Laplace's spawn biome.
- A new Otherworlder will now spawn in this biome. Will you take on the challenge?
[+] Added more content to the Quest Book.
- Updated the Skills and Nature's Aura pages.
Mortal Cultivation Content (Part 1):
[+] Added two new skills: Myriad Swords Return and Sword Flight.
- Myriad Swords Return: Summons countless flying swords that obey the player's commands.
- Sword Flight: Uses your sword as a flying mount.
[+] Added new blocks and items, including the Scholar Table, Torn Page, Spirit Glasses, Ancient Stele, and Ancient Book.
- Scholar Table: Used for analysis, crafting, and deciphering.
- Torn Page: Can be found in ruins throughout the world.
- Spirit Glasses: Allow the wearer to see runes.
- Ancient Stele: Found within cave structures.
- Ancient Book: Obtained through deciphering.
[+] Added a new deciphering mechanic.
- Connect spiritual energy pathways to uncover the secrets of an Ancient Book and obtain new secret manuals.
[+] Added a new Spirit Root: Overlord Body.
- Increases maximum health, resistance, and luck.
[+] Added Stele Caves to world generation.
- Deep underground, you may discover a water-filled cavern with an island and an Ancient Stele at its center.
Adjustments & Optimizations:
[+] Optimized chunk loading and improved chunk-loading performance.
[+] Adjusted the Flügel race's starting skills.
- Removed Heaven's Strike from its starting skills and set it to an unlearned state.
[+] Removed several skills from the Unique Skill pool and reclassified them as Extra Skills.
Removals:
[+] Removed the airship structure mod.
- Removed an unnecessarily complicated mod.

zh_cn.title: 发现整合包新版本
message: 检测到整合包有新版本。
当前版本：{current_version}
最新版本：{latest_version}
更新内容：
修复内容：
[+] 修复“魔矿感知”技能无法穿透方块探测矿物的问题。
- 此前该技能只能使矿物发光，无法隔着方块显示矿物。
[+] 修复大部分背景音乐无法播放的历史遗留问题。
- 此前只有部分曲目能够正常播放。
[+] 修复光影设置界面可能因模组冲突而显示空白的问题。
新增内容：
[+] 为灵狐种族选择界面添加背景。
[+] 添加玩家种族模型开关，可通过配置启用或关闭玩家种族模型。
- 使用会改变默认史蒂夫模型的模组时，此配置可能会派上用场。
[+] 新增两个究极技能：玛纳斯·希耶尔、数奇之王·福尔图娜。
- 技能详细介绍请查看 Wiki。
[+] 添加更多生物群系，并已适配 Tensura 生物刷新。
- 新的生物群系将带来更多样的冒险体验。
[+] 添加“自然灵气”任务章节及兼容联动补丁。
- 进一步丰富整合包玩法，未来或可实现更多自动化生产。
[+] 将远古森林添加为拉普拉斯的刷新群系。
- 新的异世界人将在此群系中刷新，你会前往挑战吗？
[+] 为任务书添加更多内容。
- 更新技能页与自然灵气页。
凡人修仙内容（第一部分）：
[+] 新增两个技能：万剑归宗、御剑飞行。
- 万剑归宗：召唤无数飞剑并听从玩家指挥。
- 御剑飞行：将手中的剑作为飞行器。
[+] 新增书桌台、残页、灵镜、石碑、古书等方块与物品。
- 书桌台：用于解析、制作与解密。
- 残页：可在野外遗迹中发现。
- 灵镜：佩戴后能够看见符文。
- 石碑：可在洞穴结构中发现。
- 古书：通过解密获得的物品。
[+] 新增“解密”机制。
- 串联灵力路径，解开古书的秘密并获得新秘籍。
[+] 新增灵根“霸体”。
- 提升最大生命值、抗性与幸运。
[+] 在世界生成中添加石碑洞穴。
- 深入地底后，或许能发现一座被水环绕、中央岛屿上矗立着石碑的洞穴。
调整与优化：
[+] 优化区块加载，提升区块加载性能。
[+] 调整天翼种的初始技能。
- 将“天击”移出初始技能，并设置为未学习状态。
[+] 将部分技能移出独特技能池，并重新分类为额外技能。
移除内容：
[+] 移除飞艇结构模组。
- 移除不必要且过于繁琐的模组。
请到官网或者夸克网盘下载整合包。
